# IMDb Mobile

> > IMDb Mobile is the mobile version of the Internet Movie Database, providing rankings, ratings, and detailed information about movies, TV shows, and entertainment industry professionals.

IMDb Mobile (m.imdb.com) offers curated charts and rankings of the most popular and highest-rated films and television series, along with comprehensive cast and crew information. The platform serves as a primary resource for discovering trending and critically acclaimed entertainment across multiple genres.

## Key Topics

- IMDb ratings
- Top 250 movies
- Top 250 TV shows
- Movie rankings
- TV series rankings
- Popularity charts
- User ratings
- Breaking Bad
- Game of Thrones
- Drama series
- Documentary series
- Cast and crew credits
- Bollywood filmography
- Trending entertainment
- Highest-rated films

## Top Rankings & Charts

- [IMDb Top 250 movies](https://m.imdb.com/chart/top/?ref_=chtbtm_ql_3): IMDb's top 250 movies ranked by user ratings
- [Top 250 TV shows](https://m.imdb.com/chart/toptv/?ref_=watch_fanfav_nv_menu): IMDb's top 250 TV shows ranked by user ratings
- [Most popular movies](https://m.imdb.com/chart/moviemeter/?ref_=watch_fanfav_nv_menu): Trending movies ranked by IMDb user popularity
- [Most popular TV shows](https://m.imdb.com/chart/tvmeter/?ref_=chtbtm_ql_5): Trending TV shows ranked by IMDb user popularity

## Cast & Crew Information

- [Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace (Video Game 1999) - Full cast & crew - IMDb](https://m.imdb.com/title/tt0215208/fullcredits/): Full cast and crew credits for Star Wars video game
